title: Pentagon averts cyber pay cuts — for now — with one-year C-MIP ‘transition plan’
summary: After the services scrambled to prepare for the new program and leaders warned subordinates about looming pay cuts, the Pentagon authorized the military branches to preserve their legacy incentive pay programs for a year. The plan averts immediate financial blows to the cyber force that experts said could sink morale at a time when the field needs to focus on an increasingly tumultuous domain.
